proof_scope: tau#340: tau run dispatches tau_agent nodes through the native adapter over SciLLM

claims.proves: tau run compiles and dispatches tau_agent nodes through execute_tau_agent_node with a ScillmTransportProvider selected by tau.agent_requirement.v1 against live SciLLM discovery; native read-only tools run under ToolPolicy; a live reviewer read back a random nonce through the real CLI with tool-effect receipts, settlement, node receipt, and SQLite agent events; preflight rejects disallowed paths, unsupported tools, unavailable profiles, and malformed nodes with provider_invoked=false; existing command/skill CLI dispatch still passes its suite.
claims.does_not_prove: provider semantic quality beyond nonce recall, write-capable native workers, Herdr-hosted native nodes (tau#315), or GOAL.md completion.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: The documented tau run CLI executes a tau_agent node as a tool-capable Tau-native reviewer over a live SciLLM transport profile, settles only from Tau-admitted evidence, and blocks malformed/unsupported/unavailable native nodes before any provider or tool execution.
